description: Repeated-question detection. One conversation in which ten questions were asked and answered. Each candidate is a question someone might send next; label REPEAT if it asks for information the contact already gave, NEW otherwise. Written by the same author as the rules (see BENCHMARK_REPORT.md: not an independent test set).
